summary: TOYO Co., Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the resignation of CFO and director Raymond Chung effective June 30, 2026, and the appointment of Yasunari Harada as CFO and director effective July 1, 2026. The resignation was not due to any disagreement with the company. Mr. Harada has over 30 years of experience in management and international finance, including roles at Société Générale, BNP Paribas, and Morgan Stanley. The company entered into standard employment and indemnification agreements with Mr. Harada. This is a routine management succession filing with no special-situation terms; no price, premium, or deal mechanics are involved. Watch for any future strategic shifts under the new CFO.
